questions.q: When does Paul say God chose us in Christ?
options: Before the foundation of the world
On the day of our baptism

questions.q: After believing the Good News, what were the Ephesians sealed with?
What does Paul pray will happen to the eyes of their hearts?
options: That they will be opened to the poor
That they will be kept from evil
That they will see the Lord's return

questions.q: What does Paul call the Holy Spirit in relation to our inheritance?
In him we have our redemption through his blood, ____, according to the riches of his grace.
He gave him to be head over all things for the assembly, which is ____, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
God has blessed us with every spiritual blessing ____ in Christ.

items: Predestined for adoption as children
The mystery of his will made known
Paul gives thanks for their faith and love
Christ seated at God's right hand

questions.q: Paul says he stopped praying for the Ephesians once he heard of their faith.
Paul says Christ is far above every name, not only in this age but also in the one to come.
What does Paul say Christ broke down between Jews and Gentiles?
What does Paul say we were created in Christ Jesus for?
Who does Paul say is the chief cornerstone of God's household?
How does Paul describe the spirit now working in the children of disobedience?
options: The prince of the power of the air

questions.q: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; ____.
questions.answer: it is the gift of God
wrong: it is the work of Christ

questions.q: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in ____.
You are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are ____ with the saints and of the household of God.

items: Dead in transgressions and sins
God, rich in mercy, made us alive
Gentiles once separate from Christ
Built into a holy temple in the Lord

questions.q: Paul says Christ preached peace only to those who were near.
Paul says Christ created in himself one new man out of the two, making peace.
What mystery does Paul say has now been revealed about the Gentiles?
options: They are fellow heirs and members of the body
They must first keep the law
They will be saved only after Israel

questions.q: How does Paul describe himself at the start of the chapter?
options: The prisoner of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles
A servant freed from his chains
The first of all the apostles

questions.q: What does Paul call himself when describing the grace given to him?
options: The very least of all saints

questions.q: Through what is God's manifold wisdom made known to the powers in the heavenly places?
That Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, ____, may be strengthened.
questions.answer: being rooted and grounded in love

questions.q: And to know Christ's love which ____, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
I bow my knees to the Father, from whom ____ in heaven and on earth is named.

items: The mystery made known by revelation
Grace to preach Christ's unsearchable riches
Do not lose heart at my troubles
The width, length, height, and depth

questions.q: Paul says this mystery was made known clearly in other generations.
Paul says that in Christ we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith.
What does Paul say not to let the sun go down on?
Why does Paul say Christ gave apostles, prophets, evangelists, shepherds, and teachers?
options: For perfecting the saints and building up the body
To rule over the Gentile assemblies
To punish those who teach error

questions.q: What should a person who used to steal do instead?
options: Labor so he has something to give the needy
Repay four times what he took

questions.q: Paul says immature children are tossed back and forth and carried about by what?
There is one body and one Spirit, one Lord, ____, one God and Father of all.
Don't grieve ____, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
But speaking truth ____, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ.

items: Walk worthily of your calling
He ascended on high and gave gifts
No longer walk as the Gentiles walk
Put away the old man, put on the new

questions.q: Paul says to put away falsehood and speak truth, because we are members of one another.
Paul says the new man has been created in the likeness of Adam.
What does Paul tell husbands to do?
options: Love their wives as Christ loved the assembly
Teach their wives the law at home

questions.q: Instead of being drunk with wine, what does Paul tell them to do?
Why does Paul tell them to redeem the time?
What does Paul say a covetous man is?
For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. ____.
Speaking to one another in ____; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord.
Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and ____.

items: Be imitators of God as beloved children
No fellowship with the deeds of darkness
Subject to one another in the fear of Christ
A great mystery about Christ and the assembly

questions.q: Paul says the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ is the head of the assembly.
Paul says Christ cleansed the assembly by the washing of water with the law.
What does Paul say our wrestling is NOT against?
Which commandment does Paul call the first commandment with a promise?
options: You shall have no other gods

questions.q: What does Paul tell masters to give up?
Whom is Paul sending to tell them how he is doing?
Above all, taking up ____, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
Stand therefore, having truth buckled around your waist, and having put on ____.
Pray for me, to make known the mystery of the Good News, for which I am ____.

items: Children, obey your parents
Servants, obey your earthly masters
Put on the whole armor of God
Pray for me to speak boldly

questions.q: Paul tells fathers not to provoke their children to wrath.
Paul says servants should work hardest when their masters' eyes are on them.
